subject.title: fix(realtime): add timeout to WebRTC offer requests

question: Should the WebRTC offer exchange use an unconditional 30-second client deadline on the current head?
rationale: The threshold resolves an indefinite hang but intentionally changes availability for slow successful exchanges, and repository behavior does not already define the cutoff.

options.title: Keep 30 seconds with proof
options.body: Retain the scoped deadline after exact-head browser evidence confirms timeout and user-stop cleanup behavior.

options.title: Revise the timeout policy
options.body: Select a different threshold or strategy before merge if slow offers should not fail unconditionally after 30 seconds.

recommendation.title: Keep 30 seconds with proof
recommendation.body: Retain the scoped deadline after exact-head browser evidence confirms timeout and user-stop cleanup behavior.
